propositions: compact-all must select tickets both by backfill (no snapshot + foldable events) and by recurrence (foldable count exceeding threshold), converging after one fold writes a snapshot and brings live count under threshold

A 6-hourly scheduled sweep via GitHub Actions reuses reconcile-bridge.yml's recipe (ephemeral runner, store worktree, bot identity) to amortize compaction work where CI exists without holding the store lock across agent-visible operations

Operation-linked trigger after close path releases the lock checks in O(1) whether the just-written ticket or the last-sweep timestamp warrant spawning a detached compaction worker, ensuring compaction works in environments without CI and without local cron

Stamped advisory locks using shared ownership and staleness semantics inherited from drain lock prevent concurrent compactors; Windows is a v1 no-op; tri-state knob (async detach / always inline / off) makes the fold testable and disableable

Honest reporting counts a fold as compacted only when observing a new *-SNAPSHOT.json artifact, not from return code; --dry-run and --no-commit never push; a sweep folding nothing still performs best-effort push to avoid stranding earlier unpushed writes

Selection must filter on foldable events (older than horizon) and reuse the fold's own event predicate to prevent churning on tickets whose excess events are all inside the horizon, while one history walk per sweep hoisted out of lock and scoped staging prevent the sweep from reintroducing per-ticket or per-event lock stalls
